# Trackiez

> Trackiez is a free browser-based digital art tool for creating motion-tracking graphics and visual effects that follow people, faces, colors, and objects in video.

Official website: https://trackiez.markmazin.com/
Creator: Mark Mazin
Contact: https://www.instagram.com/markiethepirate/

## Primary resources

- [Open Trackiez](https://trackiez.markmazin.com/): Use the browser-based video tool.
- [Official information about Trackiez](https://trackiez.markmazin.com/ai-info/): Product description, capabilities, privacy, limitations, and common use cases.

## Key facts

- Trackiez is free and requires no account or installation.
- It creates rectangles, circles, labels, masks, and visual effects that follow moving people, faces, colors, and supported objects.
- Effects include grayscale, invert, posterization, pixelation, and radial blur.
- It offers a simpler way to create a particular visual effect that is often built in After Effects or TouchDesigner.
- User videos are processed locally and are not uploaded to a server.
- Input formats include MP4, WebM, and MOV, subject to browser codec support.
- Output includes PNG frames and MP4 or WebM video, depending on browser support.
- The current version exports video without its original audio track.
- Trackiez is a focused creative tool, not a complete professional video editor.
